roles.pageSubtitle: A “Hybrid” permission model: roles set the default access level, while per-item sharing overrides on top.
roles.layer1Body: The workspace role (Owner → Guest) sets the default level for every public item and decides who can administer.
roles.layer2Body: Grant access per project/task/doc (to a person or a <team>team</team>) — the most specific item + highest level wins.
roles.defaultLevelDesc: Applies to public items when nothing is shared individually.
roles.capDesc: Derived directly from server/lib/permissions.ts — the table always matches the enforcing code.

full.label: Full
full.desc: Full control: edit, share, delete, change permissions.

edit.label: Edit
edit.desc: Edit content & tasks, but no permission changes / high-level deletes.

comment.label: Comment
comment.desc: View and comment, no content edits.

none.label: Needs sharing
none.desc: No default access — must be shared per item.

roles.resolveOrder: Resolve order: creator → owner/admin → personal grant → team grant → private/guest item without a grant = no access → the role's default level.
roles.customDesc: Like ClickUp Custom Roles: create your own roles and toggle each capability. This needs a new role_permissions table (DB migration) — to be rolled out once agreed, since the Neon DB is shared.
